free_tier.stated: On the Free plan, docs are limited to 1GB of attachments.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: the Free-plan doc-limits page states no single attachment may exceed 10MB

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: deleted docs remain in the trash for 7 days and are then permanently removed

egress.terms: Free; attachments served from Coda's CDN with signed URLs

tooling: Coda REST API (docs/tables/rows) can create rows with attachment values by URL; API is size-gated at 125 MB doc size
chaining: Per-record unlimited: 1 GB x unlimited personal docs x unlimited free workspaces. Personal (unshared) docs on Free have 'no object or row limits', so the 1 GB/doc is the only ceiling - 1,000 docs = 1 TB in one free account.
limits_note: 1 GB per doc total attachments; 10 MB per single attachment; docs over 125 MB lose the API and break cross-doc sync; shared docs on Free limited to 50 objects and 1,000 rows (so the docs must stay unshared to stay unlimited); 35 time-based automations/month

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up is by an emailed link or a password.

reliability_note: Sharing a doc flips it into the 50-object / 1,000-row regime and can lock it read-only after a 14-day grace period - the unlimited mode is strictly the unshared mode, which also kills public download links.
confidence_note: the Free-plan doc-limits page states that no single attachment can be over 10MB
